name: Drain Cleaning
short: Fast, thorough removal of tough clogs in sinks, tubs, showers and main lines.
intro: A slow or stopped drain usually means grease, hair, soap or roots are building up inside the pipe. We clear the clog completely, not just enough to get water moving, and tell you what caused it so it doesn't come back next week.
signs: Water drains slowly or backs up in the sink, tub or shower
Gurgling sounds from drains or the toilet
Bad smells coming up from a drain
More than one fixture backing up at the same time
includes: Find where the clog is and what's causing it
Clear it with the right tool for the pipe: snake, auger or jetter
Test every affected fixture before we leave
Camera inspection if the clog keeps coming back

name: Hydro Jetting
short: High-pressure water that scours grease, scale and roots out of the whole pipe.
intro: A snake punches a hole through a clog. Hydro jetting cleans the pipe wall from end to end with high-pressure water, which removes the grease, scale and root growth that cause repeat backups. It's the go-to for main lines, restaurants and older homes.
signs: The same drain clogs again a few weeks after snaking
Grease buildup in kitchen or restaurant lines
Tree roots found in the sewer line
Slow drains throughout the house
includes: Camera check to confirm the pipe can handle jetting
Full-diameter cleaning of the line
Before-and-after camera footage when needed
Recommendations if the pipe itself is damaged

name: Sewer Line Repair
short: Cracked, root-damaged or collapsed sewer lines repaired or replaced.
intro: Your main sewer line carries everything out of the house. When roots, shifting soil or old age crack it, you get backups, soggy spots in the yard and sewage smells. We find the damaged section with a camera and repair just what needs it whenever possible.
signs: Several drains backing up at once
Sewage smell indoors or in the yard
Wet, sunken or extra-green patches of lawn
Water coming up from a floor drain or cleanout
includes: Camera inspection to locate the problem
Clear explanation of repair options and prices
Spot repair or full line replacement
Final camera check after the repair

name: Sewer Camera Inspection
short: A waterproof camera shows exactly what's inside your drain or sewer line.
intro: Instead of guessing, we run a camera through the line and show you what we see: roots, cracks, sags, grease or a lost toy. It's the fastest way to find the cause of repeat clogs, and smart to do before buying an older home.
signs: Recurring clogs with no clear cause
Buying or selling a home with older plumbing
Before hydro jetting or sewer repair
Tree roots growing near the sewer line
includes: Camera run through the drain or main line
Locating the depth and position of problems
Video and a plain-language summary for you
Recommendations with prices, if anything needs fixing

name: Water Heater Repair
short: No hot water, not enough hot water, or a leaking tank, fixed fast.
intro: Most water heater problems come down to a few parts: a thermocouple, gas valve, heating element, thermostat or a tank full of sediment. We diagnose it on the first visit, carry common parts on the truck and tell you honestly when a repair is worth it and when replacing makes more sense.
signs: No hot water or it runs out fast
Rumbling or popping noises from the tank
Rusty or smelly hot water
Water pooling around the base of the heater
includes: Full diagnosis of gas or electric units
Repair with parts from the truck when possible
Safety check of venting and relief valve
Repair-or-replace advice with prices for both

name: Tank Water Heater Installation
short: New gas or electric tank water heaters, installed to code.
intro: Tank water heaters usually last 8 to 12 years. When yours is leaking or worn out, we help you pick the right size for your household, haul the old one away and install the new one to current code, including seismic straps and proper venting.
signs: The tank is leaking from the bottom
The heater is more than 10 years old
Repairs keep adding up
Your household needs more hot water
includes: Help choosing size and fuel type
Removal and disposal of the old heater
Installation with seismic straps, venting and expansion tank as required
Permit when required by your city

name: Tankless Water Heater Installation
short: Endless hot water and a smaller footprint with a tankless system.
intro: Tankless water heaters heat water on demand, so you don't run out and you're not paying to keep a tank hot all day. We size the unit for your home, upgrade gas and venting when needed, and handle service and descaling on existing tankless units too.
signs: You keep running out of hot water
You want to free up space in the garage
Your tank heater is due for replacement
Your tankless unit shows error codes or loses heat
includes: Sizing based on your fixtures and household
Gas line and venting upgrades if needed
Professional installation and startup
Flushing and descaling for existing units

name: Slab Leak Detection & Repair
short: Leaks under your foundation found precisely and repaired with minimal digging.
intro: A leak in a pipe under the concrete slab can waste water and damage floors for months before you see it. We use leak detection equipment to pinpoint the spot, then recommend the least disruptive fix: a spot repair, or rerouting the line around the slab.
signs: Water bill jumped with no change in use
Warm or damp spots on the floor
Sound of running water when everything is off
Cracks in flooring or mold smells
includes: Electronic leak detection to pinpoint the leak
Explanation of repair vs. reroute options
Repair with minimal damage to floors
Pressure test to confirm the fix

name: Pipe Repair & Repiping
short: Leaking pipes repaired, and old galvanized or failing lines replaced.
intro: From a single leaking joint to a whole-home repipe, we fix the problem and check what caused it, like high water pressure or corroded galvanized pipe. Repiping with PEX or copper restores water pressure and ends the cycle of leaks in older homes.
signs: Visible leaks, drips or water stains
Low water pressure throughout the house
Rusty or discolored water
Older galvanized steel pipes
includes: Repair of leaking or damaged sections
Water pressure check and regulator service
Whole-home repiping with PEX or copper
Patch-ready openings and cleanup

name: Gas Line Installation & Repair
short: Safe gas line repairs and new lines for appliances, BBQs and fire pits.
intro: Gas work needs to be done right the first time. We repair leaking gas lines and run new lines for ranges, dryers, water heaters, outdoor kitchens and fire pits, then pressure test everything before turning it on. If you smell gas, leave the house and call your gas company's emergency line first.
signs: Smell of gas near an appliance or line
Adding a gas range, dryer or BBQ
Converting from electric to gas
Upgrading for a tankless water heater
includes: Leak detection and repair
New gas line runs, indoor and outdoor
Pressure testing before turn-on
Permit when required

name: Clogged Toilet Repair
short: Fast, clean solutions for backups, overflows and stubborn toilet clogs.
intro: When the plunger doesn't work, we clear the clog without damaging the toilet and check whether the problem is in the toilet or further down the line. If one toilet keeps clogging, we find out why.
signs: Toilet won't flush or keeps overflowing
Water rises slowly and drains over minutes
More than one toilet backing up
Gurgling from the toilet when other fixtures drain
includes: Clog removal with a closet auger
Check of the drain line beyond the toilet
Inspection of flapper, fill valve and wax seal
Cleanup when we're done

name: Toilet Installation
short: New toilets installed level, sealed and leak-free.
intro: Whether you're replacing a cracked toilet or upgrading to a water-saving model, we remove the old one, check the flange, install the new toilet with a fresh seal and supply line, and haul the old one away.
signs: Cracked bowl or tank
Toilet rocks or leaks at the base
Constant running that repairs haven't fixed
Remodel or upgrade to a high-efficiency toilet
includes: Removal and disposal of the old toilet
Flange inspection and repair
New wax seal and supply line
Leak test and level check

name: Faucet Repair
short: Dripping, leaking or low-flow faucets fixed in the kitchen, bath or outdoors.
intro: A dripping faucet can waste thousands of gallons a year. We replace worn cartridges, washers and O-rings, fix leaks under the sink, and tell you if the faucet is worth repairing or ready to be replaced.
signs: Dripping spout or leaking handle
Water under the sink
Low flow or uneven spray
Handle that's stiff or hard to turn
includes: Diagnosis of the leak or flow problem
Cartridge, washer and seal replacement
Supply line and shutoff valve check
Repair-or-replace recommendation

name: Faucet Installation
short: Kitchen, bathroom and laundry faucets installed cleanly.
intro: Bought a new faucet or want help picking one? We install kitchen, bathroom, bar and laundry faucets, replace old shutoff valves and supply lines while we're there, and make sure there are no leaks before we leave.
signs: Upgrading your kitchen or bathroom
Old faucet keeps leaking
Switching to a pull-down or touchless faucet
Corroded shutoff valves under the sink
includes: Removal of the old faucet
New supply lines and shutoffs as needed
Installation and leak test
Old fixture haul-away

name: Garbage Disposal Installation & Repair
short: Jammed, leaking or humming disposals repaired or replaced.
intro: Disposals jam, leak and wear out. We clear jams, fix leaks at the flange and drain connections, and install new disposals sized for how you cook, including the electrical connection to an existing outlet.
signs: Disposal hums but doesn't spin
Leaking under the sink
Trips the reset button often
Bad smells that cleaning doesn't fix
includes: Jam clearing and reset
Leak repair at flange and connections
New disposal installation
Drain line check

name: Shower & Tub Installation
short: Shower valves, tubs and fixtures installed for remodels and repairs.
intro: We handle the plumbing side of bathroom remodels and repairs: new shower valves, tub and shower fixtures, drains and supply lines. We also fix leaking valves, low pressure and temperature problems in existing showers.
signs: Leaking shower head or valve
Water too hot or too cold
Bathroom remodel in progress
Slow-draining tub or shower
includes: Shower and tub valve replacement
Fixture and trim installation
Drain and overflow work
Pressure and temperature testing

name: Water Softener Installation
short: Softeners and whole-home filtration that stop hard-water scale.
intro: Many homes around Sacramento, especially those on well or groundwater, have hard water. It leaves spots on dishes, scale on fixtures and buildup inside water heaters. A water softener or whole-home filtration system fixes it at the source and helps your appliances last longer.
signs: White scale on faucets and shower heads
Spotty dishes and glassware
Dry skin or dull hair after showering
Water heater full of sediment
includes: Help choosing a softener or filter system
Installation with bypass valve
Drain and electrical connections
Setup and how-to for regeneration and salt

name: Sump Pump Installation & Repair
short: Sump pumps installed, repaired and tested before the rain comes.
intro: A sump pump keeps water out of crawl spaces, basements and low spots. We install new pumps, replace failed ones, and test float switches and discharge lines so the pump works when the next storm hits.
signs: Pump runs constantly or not at all
Standing water in the crawl space
Loud grinding or rattling
Pump is more than 7 to 10 years old
includes: Pump installation or replacement
Float switch and check valve testing
Discharge line inspection
Battery backup options

name: 24/7 Emergency Plumbing
short: Burst pipes, sewer backups and major leaks, handled day or night.
intro: Some problems can't wait until morning. Call our 24/7 emergency line and we'll talk you through shutting off the water and get a plumber headed your way. While you wait, turn off the main water valve and keep people away from water near outlets.
signs: Burst or leaking pipe
Sewage backing up into the house
No water at all
Water heater leaking heavily
includes: 24/7 phone line
Help shutting off water over the phone
Emergency repair to stop the damage
Follow-up plan for permanent repairs

name: Commercial Plumbing
short: Plumbing for restaurants, salons, offices and apartment buildings.
intro: When a drain backs up at your business, every hour costs money. We work with restaurants, salons, offices, property managers and multi-unit buildings on drain cleaning, water heaters, fixtures and repairs, and we schedule around your hours.
signs: Backed-up sinks or floor drains
Grease buildup in kitchen lines
Water heater can't keep up
Ongoing maintenance for rental units
includes: Drain cleaning and hydro jetting
Commercial water heater service
Fixture repair and replacement
Scheduling around business hours
